verdict.rationale: SvelteKit is documented on svelte.dev as the Svelte meta-framework, comparable to Next/Nuxt. It provides file-based routing via src/routes with server rendering, and mixes SSR, SSG, SPA and ISR rendering. Hands-on users corroborate its server-vs-client loading and form actions. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of the data-fetching API (load functions) in the evidence, since data loading is evidenced only by community reports.

support.subject: As a developer, I can use an official full-stack meta-framework built on top of the framework for routing and data fetching

citations.quote: If you're coming from React, SvelteKit is similar to Next. If you're coming from Vue, SvelteKit is similar to Nuxt.
You create pages by adding files to the `src/routes` directory of your project. These will be server-rendered so that a user's first visit to your app is as fast as possible
SvelteKit allows for nicely mixing and matching different rendering types on different pages.
It is now very clear in what order items load and what loads on the server vs the client. Form actions are also amazing.
